headline: Committee approves transfer of all Central Bank profit for 2026 to the budget of the Kyrgyz Republic
summary: A Kyrgyz parliamentary committee has approved sending all National Bank profit for 2026 to the republican budget. The draft constitutional law still has to pass further stages.
why: Central bank profit transfers can help fund government spending, and they reflect the financial position of the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic.
original_headline: Комитет одобрил перечисление всей прибыли Нацбанка за 2026 год в бюджет КР
